_comment: Media register. verified = identity + existence confirmed. primarySource = subject's own channel or publisher of record. Tier C items are retained with verified:false so future evidence can promote them; they are NOT rendered on the site.

tiers.A: Local press - independent, corroborates identity. Rendered on /medya.
tiers.B: PR-style placement - real URL, promotional copy. Rendered separately and labelled.
tiers.C: Claimed in brief, not found. Not rendered.
